1、本游戏是一款3D角色扮演类回合制游戏，适用于年满<unbreak>12</unbreak>周岁及以上的用户，建议未成年人在家长监护下使用游戏产品。

2、本游戏基于架空背景展开剧情，用户可通过对话、交互、完成任务推进剧情，游戏内还可以自由探索场景地图。游戏中有需要使用游戏角色进行的人机对战，玩法基于一定难度的思考判断，鼓励玩家随机应变、制定策略来取得对战胜利。游戏中有少量自定义文字系统，该社交系统遵循相关法律法规进行管理。

3、本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，认证为未成年的用户将受到以下游戏限制：
未满8周岁的用户不能充值；8周岁以上未满<unbreak>16</unbreak>周岁的未成年用户，单次充值金额不得超过<unbreak>50</unbreak>元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过<unbreak>200</unbreak>元人民币；<unbreak>16</unbreak>周岁以上的未成年用户，单次充值金额不得超过<unbreak>100</unbreak>元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过<unbreak>400</unbreak>元人民币。
游戏仅会在周五、周六、周日和法定节假日的<unbreak>20</unbreak>时至<unbreak>21</unbreak>时，向未成年人提供1小时游戏服务。

4、游戏玩法鼓励玩家积极思考，制定和应用策略来取得对战的胜利。同时，在游戏中呈现了精美细腻的画面效果，能够为玩家提供优质的视觉体验。

◆ Trailblazer Profile ◆
Trailblazers can check here to view and edit their personal summary and review their Trailblaze Activity.
● Trailblaze Activity includes updates about the 5-star characters or Light Cones you've obtained for the first time, Treasures Lightward, Currency Wars, and Simulated Universe completion statuses, along with event completion statuses, and more.
● Other Trailblazers can view your Trailblaze Activity, and you can choose to stop showing your Trailblaze Activity to other Trailblazers in your Social Settings.
● The Trailblaze Activity is kept for up to <unbreak>30</unbreak> days and is limited to <unbreak>15</unbreak> entries max.

◆ Character Showcase ◆
● Trailblazers can display their obtained characters they wish to showcase here.
● Other Trailblazers can view all your showcased characters.

◆ Collection Showcase ◆
● Trailblazers can showcase their various collection statistics here.
● Other Trailblazers can view your collection showcase, and you can choose to stop showing your collection showcase to other Trailblazers in your Social Settings.

◆ Battle Records Showcase ◆
● Trailblazers can showcase the Battle Records for Treasures Lightward, current rank of Currency Wars, and titles obtained in the highest difficulty worlds cleared in the Simulated Universe to their friends.
● At the same time, Trailblazers can select whether to display their Battle Records to showcase to their friends in their Friend List.
● Friends can view your displayed Battle Record information, but you can choose to stop showing your Battle Records to your Friend List in your Social Settings.

◆ Support ◆
●  Set support characters to help other players.
● When other players use your support characters to complete a battle, Trailblazers can get a certain amount of rewards. These rewards can be obtained <unbreak>10</unbreak> times a day.
● Once the rewards accumulate to a certain amount, exceeding the limit won't grant additional rewards.

◆Synthesis◆
A service provided by the Express, unlocked when you reach a certain Trailblaze Level.
You can use Synthesis to upgrade low-level items to high-level items of the same type.
Open the Synthesis menu and select an item from the catalog to check what's needed to perform Synthesis.

◆Character Building◆
Use Travel Encounters, Adventure Log, or Traveler's Guide to increase Character Level.
Character Level affects a character's base stats.

◆Character Ascension◆
When a character reaches a certain level, you must use specified materials to Ascend the character. Ascension will further increase the character's base stats and raise their Level Cap.
Some high-level Ascensions have requirements on Equilibrium Level and Trailblaze Level.

◆Light Cones◆
Destiny lies within the Light Cones.
After equipping a Light Cone, characters will receive base stat boost. If the character's Path matches that of the Light Cone, a unique Light Cone effect will also be activated.

◆Light Cone Leveling Up◆
You may use materials or other Light Cones to level up a Light Cone.
Leveling up a Light Cone will increase its base stats.

◆Light Cone Ascension◆
When a Light Cone reaches a certain level, you must use specific materials to ascend it. Ascension will further increase the Light Cone's base stats and raise its Level Cap.
Ascensions at certain phases will require specific Equilibrium Levels and Trailblaze Levels.

◆Light Cone Superimposition◆
Superimposition can be conducted with Light Cones of the same name. Superimposition increases the level of the Light Cone's ability, up to a maximum level of 5.
Superimposition does not cost credits.

◆Operation Briefing◆
Follow the instructions and complete missions stated in the Operation Briefing.
Once missions and rewards for the current part have been completed and claimed, the next part of Operation Briefing will be unlocked.

◆Daily Training◆
Follow the instructions and complete missions stated in Daily Training to increase Activity. You will gain correspondent rewards when your Activity reaches a certain value. Training missions will refresh daily.

◆Survival Index◆
Trailblazer can check information about Calyxes, Stagnant Shadows, Caverns of Corrosion, and Echoes of War in Survival Index after they have been unlocked.

◆Navigation◆
By utilizing the navigation system of the Astral Express, Trailblazer can move between worlds and regions.

◆Star Rail Map◆
The worlds explored by Trailblazer will be marked on Star Rail Map. It allows Trailblazer to switch between regional maps of different worlds that mark already explored places.

◆Area Maps◆
Important coordinates of discovered places such as Space Anchors, key locations, and locations of ongoing missions can be found in area maps.
Trailblazer can teleport to desired locations by selecting the corresponding Space Anchors on the area map.

◆Calyxes◆
Calyxes are the mechanism by which the Fragmentum attempts to piece together the corroded reality to form something new.
●Calyxes are scattered across multiple regions on the map. Some Calyxes are only activated at a certain time each week.

● You can consume Trailblaze Power to defeat enemies produced by Calyxes for rewards.

● Before a challenge begins, you can choose to consume more Trailblaze Power to take on more waves of enemies all at once for more rewards.

◆Traces◆
Traces are unique stats and abilities of each character.
Traces fall into three categories, each granting different effects:
● Ability: Increases characters' ability level;
● Base Stats: Increases characters' base stats.
● Bonus Ability: Grants new passive abilities.

◆Unlocking Traces◆
Traces are unlocked in sequential order. A new Trace can only be unlocked when its prerequisites are fulfilled.
Some Traces must meet requirements on Character Level or Ascension Level to be unlocked.

◆Leveling Up Traces◆
Traces can be leveled up using certain materials until max level is reached.
Some Traces must meet requirements on Character Level or Ascension Level to be leveled up.

Achievements

◆Achievements◆
● There are many things to be achieved in your trailblazing journey. View the Achievements and your progress using the Achievement System.
● Completing corresponding events or challenges will grant you Achievements or Achievement Points, which can be used to claim Achievement Rewards.
● Based on their difficulty, Achievements are organized into 3 ranks: Gold, Silver, and Copper, with Gold being the highest rank.
● When you accumulate enough Achievement Points, your Achievement Level will be increased, earning you the corresponding rewards.
Assignments

◆Assignments◆
As the Nameless traverses worlds, the Express Crew takes on assignments from across the cosmos as a means to honor the way of Trailblaze.

● Dispatch two characters to take an assignment. Complete the assignment to receive the corresponding rewards.
● For each character of recommended Path dispatched, a bonus reward will be given at the end of the assignment.
● Each character can only be dispatched on one assignment at a time.
● You can determine how long each assignment would take. The more time spent on an assignment, the better the completion rewards.
● Canceling a dispatched assignment without completing it will immediately release the dispatched characters, but no rewards will be given.
● As you progress through the story, you will be able to take on more assignments.

Direct ticket for the Astral Express with coordinates of specific worlds, suitable for passengers who just want to go from point A to point B.\n\n"Need to catch up with an old friend? Hop on and see the universe with him/her/it/THEM!"
Exploration Points
Exploration Points
Fuel
Item used to replenish Trailblaze Power. Provides <unbreak>60</unbreak> Trailblaze Power.
Fuel canisters filled up with the dreams and courage of the Nameless.\n\n"Idealism? I prefer to call it the observer effect and human self-actualization."
Travel Encounters
Experience material for characters. Provides <unbreak>1000</unbreak> Character EXP.
A travel diary with messy handwriting and random content. It's not of much use to you.\n\n"Dan Heng, hurry up and finish reading it so you can throw it away."
Adventure Log
Experience material for characters. Provides <unbreak>5000</unbreak> Character EXP.

A neatly organized collection of educational adventure notes containing countless illustrations and texts entailing adventures from beginning to end, as well as valuable information and survival-related techniques. "Why not just digitize it and save it on a photolith disk? That'd be much more convenient." "Advanced technology is far more fragile than you'd think when faced with stellar storms and neuron flow eruptions. Besides, I'm sure the author of this book wanted people to read it in the simplest of ways."
Traveler's Guide
Experience material for characters. Provides <unbreak>20,000</unbreak> Character EXP.

Required reading for world exploration. Press the "Read" button to tune in to an attractive voice in a language you understand, telling you about the legendary encounters of renowned adventurers across different worlds as well as the precious wisdom and knowledge that they have gathered. "All-new series of the Traveler's Guide, The Chef's Manual to Galactic Cuisine, is now available for purchase." "For submissions, please connect to synesthesia beacon ERD-23θ to contact an Intelligentsia Guild representative. Method of payment can be arranged to your convenience."
Sparse Aether
Enhancement material for Light Cones, provides <unbreak>500</unbreak> Light Cone EXP.

An imaginary substance that shouldn't exist in reality. The basic material to create Light Cones. The images contained in the Light Cones become clearer when infused with this substance. "I see, so this is the supposed 'memoria' of the Garden of Recollection. No wonder the Memokeepers can set off on galactic voyages with memories."
Condensed Aether
Enhancement material for Light Cones, provides <unbreak>2000</unbreak> Light Cone EXP.

A can of Aether refined through special techniques.\n\n"Handle with care, do not drop or place pressure upon it. If damages and leaks occur, please refer to chapter II of the Leak Disaster Response Manual for emergency response."
Enhancement material for Light Cones, provides <unbreak>6000</unbreak> Light Cone EXP.
Lost Lightdust

Lightdust permeated the Fragmentum, carrying what seems to indicate the existence of another civilization.\n\n"Theosophy holds that the database used to store information of the material world is called the Akasha Records. I don't necessarily support this, but... these dust indeed store information from the past. They are like... seeds? When you water them, they can yield bountiful fruit."
Lost Gold Fragment
Carefully collected Fragmentum dust with irregular shapes. Under the right conditions, they can express specific forms of relics.\n\nWhen the stars return to the right position... Ha! Just kidding.
Relic Remains
Material salvaged from Relics.
Broken parts of a relic that are one step away from decomposing into the Lightdust floating in the Fragmentum.\n\n"Don't take them for mere scraps. I can restore them to their original state."
Tracks of Destiny
Advanced level-up material for Traces.
Your victory is secured by countless failures, and the small steps you have taken led you to the turning point of fate.
Undying Embers
Sighing embers formed when a shooting star fell from the sky.\n\n"At least they were once hot and bright."
Undying Starlight
Splendid gems formed when a shooting star fell from the sky.\n\n"Precious things stay precious."

Shattered Blade
Weapon fragments left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.

This brand represents their rank and accomplishments in the name of Destruction. The master of this weapon rides on a scarlet horse to ignite cities, to take peace from humankind, and to bring down nations akin to anthills. "The bearer of this brand is tasked with driving peace out of nations."
Lifeless Blade
Weapon remnants left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.

This brand represents their rank and accomplishments in the name of Destruction. The master of this weapon carries a strong hatred for all sentient beings. They relish in the lament of intelligent beings as sweet melodies and topple civilizations with millennia of history in the blink of an eye. "The bearer of this brand is tasked with stopping breath among the living."
Worldbreaker Blade
Broken weapon left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.

This weapon represents its owner's rank and accomplishments in the name of Destruction. The owner of this weapon makes their appearance at the end of a war to fan the embers to consume the world. Regardless of the glories of the past or the blessing of its deities, this planet is destined to return to the ashes it came from, and to wither away in the depths of the starry sky. "The bearer of this brand is tasked with purifying the world."
Arrow of the Beast Hunter
An arrowhead forged with Frost Steel by the craftsmen of Xianzhou. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.

A gift that parents give to their children who've successfully hunted their first prey at their coming of age ceremony. It is a blessing that their life would be as successful and true as an arrow heading towards its mark.\n\n"May the arrow on your waist and the sword in your sheath stay true and always find its target."
Arrow of the Demon Slayer
An arrowhead forged with Stellaris Essence by the craftsmen of Xianzhou. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.

An arrow narrower than a finger's width. It can be loaded into an electromagnetic crossbow or a thermal seeking bow as ammunition. Its power is enough to penetrate the tough shells of abominations with just one strike.\n\n"The celestial banished arrives from afar, great distances journeyed 'twixt oceans of stars. Like rain falls a cloudburst of arrows below, in a helmet reflected the bright lunar glow."
Arrow of the Starchaser
A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.

The remains of a divine construct that ordinary humans can rarely behold. What kind of force can shatter stars that are light-years away? Humanity can only imagine the power of the Lux Arrow from the ashes it left behind. Only the Furnace Master, chief of the Xianzhou artisans, has the rights to reforge the shards for those who are worthy. "The death of a star shall shine bright for ages to come."
Key of Inspiration
A mythical key that appears in the hands of the Meditative Scholars. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
It can unlock inspirations hidden deep within the conscience. To take hold of the key is to grasp at the darting embers of thought that lead to the forward path. "Eureka!"
Key of Knowledge
A mythical key that appears in the hands of the sages of the worlds. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.

It can unlock the mysteries binding the truth of the world and grants knowledge beyond the understanding of humans. No matter how the wielder attempts to display their possession of the key, no one but themselves can see its form. Some people believe that to be a gift from the heavens, while others think it's a sign of mental disorder. "I had a dream of molecules coiling up into a loop like a snake biting its own tail. I woke up realizing that this is the answer I've been looking for all along!"
Key of Wisdom
A mythical key that appears in the hands of the greatest prodigies of the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.

This is the proof of invitation to the halls of the Nous Temple. Finding the door of which this key opens is a far more arduous task than obtaining the key itself. Those who pass through the doors will immediately realize the impossibility of returning to this side. "The Erudition does not have answers to the universe, but it will teach you how to ask the right questions."
Endurance of Bronze
A crude but durable ancient hand-held bronze shield. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Preservation</color> characters.

Ancient legends entail a war where humans exhausted all primitive methods, following the gods into battle against overwhelmingly powerful beasts. This shield is a witness to that war. "There's no choice but to stop it, even if the efforts are futile."
Oath of Steel
A shield forged with irreplaceable craftsmanship from an unknown alloy. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Preservation</color> characters.

It may be a large shield, but it feels as light as a feather. Even after taking on a full charge, no marks can be seen on the face of the shield. Ancient legends tell of a war where high-spirited warriors wielded deathray-beaming spears and shields forged of Frost Steel, defended a nation destined to falter in the face of war. This shield is a witness to that war. "Powerful voices chant: 'The enemies are at our gates!'"
Safeguard of Amber
An unusual shield embedded with ambers mined from beyond the skies. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Preservation</color> characters.

The wielder of this shield is seemingly protected by an invisible shield wall, immune to fiery arrows or mountainous claws. Ancient legends entail a war where a tribal hero wielding a bronze shield charged to their death against a leviathan, together with warriors armed with fiery spears. This shield is a witness to that war. "Do not cross the line."
Obsidian of Dread
A fragment of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
Nothing can prove its noumenon. Touch gently to hear an unclear murmur from the shard. "████ ██ █ █"
Obsidian of Desolation
A chunk of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.

No reflections can be seen on the surface of the black prism. Not only does it suck in all the light, it seems to also absorb the wielder's emotions, leaving only a faint feeling of emptiness.\n\n"..."
Obsidian of Obsession
A sizable piece of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
The weak-minded and soft-willed will spend their eternity in chaos from just a simple glance into the prism.\n\n" "
Harmonic Tune
A compact music box made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Harmony</color> characters.

It plays a relaxing and joyful tune. Even through the simplistic tune, anyone with the slightest understanding of music can tell the mastery of the composer of the piece. "Grab the hands of your Family and let us dance!"
Ancestral Hymn
A music box made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Harmony</color> characters.
It plays a hymn sung by a small band. It is impossible to find out to whom the lyric of the hymn sends its praise. "Penury, trial of the Great One! Wealth, grace of the Great One!"
Stellaris Symphony
A music box with complex structures made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Harmony</color> characters.

It plays a powerful cosmic symphony.\n\n"Some astronomers believe that the revolutions of the heavenly spheres work the same as complex mechanical structures. The crystal clear and pleasant notes emitted during the movements of the stars are known as the 'Harmony of the Heavenly Spheres.'"
Seed of Abundance
A seed of blessing sown by the Aeon of Abundance. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

Those who come in contact with it are slowly healed of their wounds and illnesses. People who pray for the blessing of life while in despair will always have their prayers answered. "You shall be granted what you ask for."
Sprout of Life
A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. Barren wastelands turn into luscious grass fields, withered plants rejuvenate and blossom, and springs burst through the ground to moisten the land. As you get closer to it, your muscles and bones twitch and propagate with an unbearable itch. "Life is unfailing where the soul abounds."
Flower of Eternity
A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.

The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."
Enigmatic Ectostella
A fathomless crystal. Ascension material for the Trailblazer.

Severed from the highest of beings, this crystal reflects ever-changing mirages. The past and future intertwine on each of its countless facets, attempting to swallow up all observers.\n\n"Civilization is but a thin sheet of ice on top of the deep dark ocean of chaos."
Broken Teeth of Iron Wolf
Fragmented saw teeth left behind by automatons. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.

It is said that the smelting techniques of the Architects allowed them to make chainsaws sturdy enough to split giant boulders. Such techniques have been long lost to history.\n\n"Boss Svarog says its blade is so thin that it can cut into the gap between molecules... What are molecules?"
Endotherm Chitin
Hot, translucent substance almost like fire in the solid state. Can be used for the Ascension of Fire characters.

Strange chitin peeled off from an interdimensional creature. Although not piping hot anymore, it still radiates warmth.\n\n"It's too cold outside. But with this gemstone on you, you'll be able to travel far and wide, even to search for cities with humans left..."
Horn of Snow
Broken horn of a Frigid Prowler. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.

The Silvermane Guards would host contests where the winner must take a body part from a monster and bring it back within a set time limit. This cold broken horn must have been a trophy of one such contest.\n\n"Sir Bova, this is no moose horn and is certainly not fit for decoration above the Geomarrow furnace."
Lightning Crown of the Past Shadow
Headwear of the Guardian Shadows. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters.

Accessory left behind by the shadow of a past Guardian, telling tales of the city of Everwinter.\n\n"Svetlana the Iron Fist — her wrath as terrifying as thunder and her retribution as swift as lightning."
Storm Eye
Arrows belonged to a Stormbringer. Can be used for the Ascension of Wind characters.

Used to belong to a certain Fragmentum monster modeled after a certain kind of Voidrangers. An arrowhead can be barely seen buried in the center of the vortex.\n\n"Those who perish in the Fragmentum shall rise again where they met their demise."
Void Cast Iron
Horseshoe of a Voidranger: Trampler. Can be used for the Ascension of Quantum characters.

Rare horseshoe obtained when a Trampler of the Antimatter Legion is defeated. When no one is observing, it pops in and out of existence.\n\n"The name of the experiment? It's just called "Horseshoe of the Trampler"... "
Golden Crown of the Past Shadow
Headwear of the Decaying Shadow. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary characters.
Accessory left behind by the shadow of a past Guardian, telling tales of the city of Everwinter.\n\n"Alina the Loving — her kindness as lofty as the sky and her compassion as brilliant as gold."
Gelid Chitin
Frosty chitin emitting a cold humming. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.

Strange chitin peeled off from an interdimensional creature. Although not freezing cold anymore, it remains trembling, absorbing heat from its surroundings.\n\n"How has no one thought of selling it to worlds where they don't have air conditioners? It works like an air conditioner and sounds as loud as one, too."
Shape Shifter's Lightning Staff
A wooden staff with a pointed tip. It belonged to a shape shifter from the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters.

According to ancient Xianzhou records, those who have ascended can summon lightning and command the wind. The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus claimed to have inherited the way of the gods. By demonstrating godly power, the disciples gathered large numbers of worshipers in secret. Branches of lightning coil around this wooden staff — could it be that the disciples were indeed no mere mortals?\n\n"The mortal body is but an illusion. Truth is only revealed to those who choose to ascend."
Destroyer's Final Road
Advanced level-up material for Traces.

The leviathan's heart has stopped beating, but its mind lives on despite being trapped in a case. As long as the lid is closed, its mind is simultaneously both alive and dead, driving the engine of destruction.\n\n"Doomsday Beast, a blight made in the Warforge using what's left of a leviathan and the weeping bones of thousands of the dead. It longs for the destruction of the universe and itself."
Guardian's Lament
Advanced level-up material for Traces.

Together with this visor, the twisted wish of a Guardian also lies broken. She had wanted to find a way out for her people to escape the Everwinter, but ended up becoming a puppet of a consciousness beyond her. "Supreme Guardian, the title passed down to generations of Belobog's rulers, the one who looked after all the people — It never occurred to anyone that the Guardians themselves also long for care and protection."
Extinguished Core
The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Crude material used for enhancement.

It is a lesion that breeds evil, the impulse to sin. It is the source of the Fragmentum distortion. A heavy blow has caused this heart to stop beating and lose its luster. "Preliminary tests indicate it's some kind of hybrid: One half is primordial, and the other half is something very similar to Stellarons." — Department of Biology, Sarah Castro
Glimmering Core
The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Normal material used for enhancement.

It is a lesion that breeds evil, the impulse to sin. It is the source of the Fragmentum distortion. The heart is glimmering and the veins on it indicate it's still alive. "What kind of monster is this? Did you see it... Its face! It has the face of our previous leader!"
Squirming Core
The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Advanced material used for enhancement.

It is a lesion that breeds evil, the impulse to sin. It is the source of the Fragmentum distortion. The heart is pulsating slowly, with a residual force powerful enough to cause a new calamity. It's best to destroy it to prevent further troubles. "It's like a cancer..."
Thief's Instinct
Usurper's Scheme
Conqueror's Will
Silvermane Badge
Pin badge worn by soldiers of the Silvermane Guards. Crude material used for enhancement.
It is full of scratches from the erosion of wind and snow.\n\n"In ancient times, there was only one way Silvermane Guards could retire: Death."
Silvermane Insignia
Military rank insignia worn by captains of the Silvermane Guard. Normal material used for enhancement.
Maybe it's a proof of heroics that you can brag about to your family. Maybe it's a lucky charm that protects you from a bullet.\n\n"Times have changed."
Silvermane Medal
Medal of honor worn by soldiers of the Silvermane Guards with gallant and meritorious service. Advanced material used for enhancement.

A proof of honor awarded to those that fought against Fragmentum creatures, Underworlders, and sudden disasters. It is not usually pinned onto the recipient's chest, but rather placed onto his coffin. "Remember, young Gepard. It is not a toy: It is the destiny and blood of the Landau family."
Ancient Part
Mechanical part left behind from the Old World. Crude material used for enhancement.
Despite its size, it was cast and polished in a way that people today would struggle to replicate.\n\n"A small screw in the Old World is stronger than our armor."
Ancient Spindle
Mechanical spindle left behind from the Old World. Normal material used for enhancement.

Once taken apart, the precision components can never be put back together. Even the maintenance veterans in Belobog's Technology Division would think twice before touching it.\n\n"You idiot, the Bluecoats will only give you a few canned goods for this. Take it to Boss Svarog and you won't need to worry about food and clothing for a while."
Ancient Engine
Mechanical engine left behind from the Old World. Advanced material used for enhancement.

It uses Geomarrow as the energy source. When powered, it spews wandering auroras, not sparkles.\n\n"Only the Technology Division directly under the Supreme Guardian has access to information regarding the Old World. I lost my privileges after I was fired."
Shield
The official currency circulating in Belobog. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.

After a long era of blockades, the Overworld and Underworld denizens of Belobog have developed vastly different standards for currency.\nThe current exchange rate of shield to credits is now 1:<unbreak>50</unbreak>... Speaking of, why are credits still an official currency of Belobog? It seems people have already forgotten the answer to this question.
Ancient Coin
An old coin from a time when metal was still a plentiful resource in Belobog.
Core Module
Defective parts collected from a malfunctioning robot.\n\n"You get what you pay for. Obviously, this is worthless."
Thermal-Powered Mechanical Mining Pick
According to Sampo, it's a piece of mining equipment that he lost.\n\n"A pickaxe with a polished point might make for a decent weapon?"
Anti-Dust Mask
According to Sampo, it's a piece of mining equipment that he lost.\n\n"An ordinary respirator."
Customized Pink Safety Helmet
According to Sampo, it's a piece of mining equipment that he lost.\n\n"Put it on and you'll be the finest in the mines."
Strange Drill Ornament
A strange ornament you found in the Corridor of Fading Echoes resembling a delicate drill.\n\n"'Balakin' is inscribed onto the back. Your intuition tells you this device isn't something simple..."
Balakin Family Box

An iron box passed down by the Balakin family, containing secrets left behind by their ancestors hundreds of years ago.\n\n"My ancestors left behind the iron box, but forgot to leave its key. Funny, very funny."
Device Encryption Key

An encryption key used to activate the energy core in the restricted zone.\n\n"Despite its apparent similarities to other cores, it is clear the energy core inside the Silvermane Guard Restricted Zone is highly-customized."
Temporary Visitor Pass

A temporary pass allowing entry into the Silvermane Guard Restricted Zone.\n\n"Temporary workers in possession of this temporary pass may enter the restricted zone within three hours. Lending this pass to others is a felony, and offenders will suffer serious consequences."
Mine Cart Pin
A part used to connect the body and chassis of a mine cart.\n\n"It is this small part that supports the entire structural integrity of the mine cart."
Robot Settlement Level 1 Certification

Level-1 certification for opening the entrance of the Robot Settlement. Only those who have obtained all three certification levels can gain permission to open the door.\n\n"Hey, ow! Ow, ow, ow... Can't this robot be more gentle with a pretty girl's hand?"
Robot Settlement Level 2 Certification

Level-2 certification for opening the entrance of the Robot Settlement. Only those who have obtained all three certification levels can gain permission to open the door.\n\n"Hey, ow! Ow, ow, ow... Can't this robot be more gentle with a pretty girl's hand?"
Robot Settlement Level 3 Certification

Level-3 certification for opening the entrance of the Robot Settlement. Only those who have obtained all three certification levels can gain permission to open the door.\n\n"Hey, ow! Ow, ow, ow... Can't this robot be more gentle with a pretty girl's hand?"
Space Station Special Permit

A Space Station Special Permit issued by Asta and Arlan. Allows you to freely enter and exit most cabins of the space station.\n\n"Why not all cabins you ask? Let's just say, researchers of Herta Space Station are all crouching tigers, I don't want to limit their imaginations when it comes to unlocking things."
Mine Cart Wheelset
A part used for connecting mine cart wheels.\n\n"A sturdy axle connects two mine cart wheels."
Commercial District Key
A key that can be used in the Rivet Town Commercial District.\n\n"The Fragmentum has come and everyone has fled. What Chamber of Commerce?"
Junjun, the Cuddly Bear
A big bear doll that has been stashed away.\n\n"Natasha's hand-made bear doll. Admittedly, it is rather cute."
Treasure Map
A map that supposedly leads to treasure.\n\n"A Treasure Map that looks rather sketchy. Is it... accurate?"
Real Treasure Map
A map that supposedly leads to treasure.\n\n"A Treasure Map made a long time ago. Judging by how old it is, seems quite convincing."
Fragmentum Monster Armor
Chitin that looks like armor, taken from a Fragmentum Monster.\n\n"Who wants something like this..."
Used Item Auction Pamphlet
A pamphlet about the used item auction.\n\n"A way for vagrants to trade... an auction sounds like a good idea."
Ultra Nickel Part

Intricate parts dotted around the Disposal Site. Hardly anyone would notice these dated-looking dull little things. Iron and nickel are gifts from the shooting star, but ultra nickel is something entirely different... Produced with mysterious methods, this superalloy, though outdated in the eyes of Herta, is patented and has no competition in the entire universe.\n\n"No competition? You get one of these for 10 credits on the black market. They say you can use it to repair all the beacons in the universe, very versatile."
Red Signal Log

A signal log in which is recorded the affirmative answer from Lesley and the truth about the starquake. It is sweet yet cruel.\n\n"Knowing how Rocky is, even I can't predict what he might do when he learns the truth."
Blue Signal Log

A fake log with Lesley's answer. Whoever made this hopes to maintain the fragile balance of Rocky's life using abrupt rejection.\n\n"She will say no to him and his life will go on. It's always easier to forget than to heal."
Surveillance Footage

A clip of the footage captured by the Herta Panopticon System. With all researchers under constant watch, there's no keeping secrets.\n\n"Surveillance is the bane of secrets but also the best historian-to-be. You can trace back to the beginning of everything, be it good or bad."
Videotape: Dim Blue Dot

A videotape that recorded the intricate secrets of the space station. Its maker went the extra mile in making it secure by installing a most extraordinary security mechanism.\n\n"As if you have fallen into a space that has neither beginning nor end, you look through a standard-issue navigation visor and stare into the deepest retreat of the vast universe. In the distance, you see a dim blue dot, like a drop of water before the canvas of darkness."
Videotape: Justice

A videotape that recorded the intricate secrets of the space station. Its maker went the extra mile in making it secure by installing a most extraordinary security mechanism.\n\n"That's the most direct evidence of the power of the Aeons. The justice people are seeking seems almost amusing in the face of a doomed planet... The hollow and eerily fast utterance is proof that the last bit of the videotape has been corrupted by something."
Videotape: Doomsday

A videotape that recorded the intricate secrets of the space station. Its maker went the extra mile in making it secure by installing a most extraordinary security mechanism.\n\n"There are no reinforcements. If you can, please come back following the route we agreed on in advance. Do you copy? The intermittent sound from the cosmic radio is calling a name repeatedly. There is no reply."
Misdelivered Letter 1

An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: Dear kindhearted soul, can you buy me a stamp and post this for me? A thousand thanks!\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.
Misdelivered Letter 2

An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: To Carlo Eyre, Room B<unbreak>03</unbreak>, Building <unbreak>35</unbreak>, 6th Street, Administrative District.\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.
Misdelivered Letter 3

An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: To my one and only; my precious; my eternally youthful; my clever and witty; the one worthy of all my love to protect; the one who may not even exist: The true love of my future.\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.
Misdelivered Letter 4

An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: The trash I wrote should never see the light of day. That's fine, it can rot forever in the bottom of the dark mailbox.\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.
Milk Powder Package
One of the anonymous packages delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Milk powder and a thermal baby bottle. Very thoughtful indeed..."
Anonymous Package
Anonymous package not yet delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Next to the anonymous package lies its sender."
Thousand Stars Access Authentication

A mysterious card used to access an unknown facility. Its corner has been chipped away and the letters on it have become unrecognizable. But when you hold it under the light at a certain angle, you can see the faint letters that read "Thousand Stars."\n\n"Obviously this card was extremely valuable, but it was discarded like trash when someone lost interest... Sounds like something Herta would do."
██ Access Authentication

A mysterious card used to access an unknown facility. Its corner has been chipped away and the letters on it have become unrecognizable. But when you hold it under the light at a certain angle, you can see the faint letters that read "██." "When you run your fingers past the incomprehensible letters, you can't help but think: Maybe this card is one of those collector's edition things. Could it be that having all the cards can grant you the power to summon... that Aeon?"
Corporate Access Authentication

A mysterious card used to access an unknown facility. Its corner has been chipped away, and the letters on it have become unrecognizable. But when you hold it under the light at a certain angle, you can see the faint letters that read "Corporate."\n\n"Trust me, this is no doubt an access card used to open multiple layers of secured hatches, and it must have been developed by big corporations. The room it unlocks must also have been built by some pan-cosmic magnate."
Box of Rubbing Alcohol
A box of medical supplies urgently needed by Natasha.\n\n"Rubbing alcohol — hope it hasn't evaporated too much..."
Box of Special Painkillers
A box of medical supplies urgently needed by Natasha.\n\n"Natasha's home-made painkillers. People faint just from the smell."
Children's Book Package
One of the anonymous packages delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Children fall asleep to stories. A must-try for young parents..."
Toddler Clothing Package
One of the anonymous packages delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Soft and breathable, our quality clothing is designed to protect your baby from sweat. Perfect for silky-smooth skin."
Kluzer's Letter
Old letters that Kluzer carries around.\n\n"He didn't have the time to post them... maybe he didn't need to anymore..."
Old Photo of Balakin

An old yellowing photo. Evidence of a certain individual's part in a certain historic event. The figure in the picture did not seem to plan to let people feel the historical weight this photo should carry. "What will become of Belobog in a hundred years? Well, you'll have to see it through your eyes."
Commodity Contract
Commodity contract for the auction. Use it to get paid based on the value of the goods.\n\n"They always put 'Handle with Care' on the contract but everyone ignores it."
Geomarrow Probe
Rare relic from ancient times. Can be used with intricate Old World instruments.\n\n"A way for vagrants to trade... an auction sounds like a good idea."
Letter From the Comet Hunter

Letter from outer space by Hosea Lazaro the comet hunter — full of rubbish.\n\n"Back when I was still in the space station, I would look into the night sky in search of those faraway celestial bodies. Those clouds of stars, soft and alluring, captured my anxious heart. If you are like me, it's only a matter of time before people crown you with the title 'comet hunter'."

Xenohydro in a Case

The Xenohydro was confined within a Mystic Case in the shape of a trapezohedron, with one of the planes made from the Absolutely Objective Lens. It is observed that the Xenohydro has icy blue skin that has silver spots dotted around. If you look through other planes to observe the Xenohydro, you'll find that it looks rather different. In fact, the image of the Xenohydro will vary from person to person.\n\n"I have a feeling that compared with the Xenohydro, this case is the actual curio. It can be worth quite a lot on the curio market."
Kapo-Kali Recipe

The uncrowned king of the beverage world, a coarse slice of manly friendship, and together with a lethal dosage of humor.\n\n"A big barrel of pure caramel, a few jumping peas here and there, a handful of fresh canterbury bells, and some interdimensional leaves. Don't forget a drop of Ambergris of Abundance and a few rolls of orchid zest. How much of a kick you want is your choice."
Rusted Key
A key with its teeth all worn smooth and not looking like it can open doors anytime soon.\n\n"Rivet Town Chamber of Commerce? Ask Julian if he knows about it."
Special Autoradiograph

A treasure map decoded with a Special Autoradiograph, revealing hidden coordinates within the space station.\n\n"I heard that scoundrel left behind some good stuff in the space station. This must be where the treasure is."
Blurry Photo

An old yellowing photo. Evidence of a certain individual's part in a certain historic event. The figure in the picture did not seem to plan to let people feel the historical weight this photo should carry. "What will become of Belobog in a hundred years? Well, you'll have to see it through your eyes."
Blurry Portrait

A small circular frame with a portrait within. Evidence of a certain individual's part in a certain historic event. The figure in the picture did not seem to plan to let people feel the historical weight this photo should carry. "What will become of Belobog in a hundred years? Well, you'll have to see it through your eyes."
Portrait With a Clue

A small circular frame with a portrait. The expression of the man dressed in an old military uniform in the frame is... complicated. A clockwise-pointing arrow is drawn on the back, accompanied by the phrase "The next clue sleeps soundly in the shade of the arch." "What will become of Belobog in a hundred years? Well, you'll have to see it through your eyes."
Pela's Notes

Pela's notes with her elegant handwriting. In the note, there is a curved arrow pointing clockwise and another pointing counterclockwise. Next to the drawing, there is a comment that reads "Might have something to do with a certain kind of rotatable structure." "...G—Give me back that piece of paper, or I'll take it!"
Edited Note

Pela's notes with her elegant handwriting. The clues you find in the Fragmentum are recorded here. In the note, there is a curved arrow pointing clockwise, another pointing counterclockwise, and another pointing clockwise. Next to the drawing, there is a comment that reads "Might have something to do with a certain kind of rotatable structure." "...G—Give me back that piece of paper, or I'll take it!"
Box of Metal Plates and Bandages
Medical supplies urgently needed by Natasha.\n\n"A full box of metal plates and bandages, exactly what Natasha needs."
Solid Water
Tier 1 Synthesis Material

Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry. "...Isn't it ice?" "No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state." "...Isn't that the definition of ice?"
Basic Ingredients
Tier 1 Synthesis Material
Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal. Not particularly good, but is edible. "Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"
Phlogiston
Tier 1 Synthesis Material

Particles that form the flame. Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it. #7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence. "Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."
Metal
Tier 1 Synthesis Material

A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean. Very useful, very handy. "I've been to a planet where the locals consume metals to get superpowers. Please don't do that at home, as most metals are not digestible by humans."
Gaseous Liquid
Tier 1 Synthesis Material

Is it fog, rain, or wind? You can't tell if it's still in the container without lifting the lid. "The answer my friend, is blowing in the gaseous liquid..." "The answer is blowing in the gaseous liquid."
Seed
Tier 1 Synthesis Material
Reproductive units unique to plants. Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good. "Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."
Mechanical Parts
Tier 2 Synthesis Material

Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions. Without them, nothing can be made. "With the same parts, Screwllum can make entire planets and create cyborgs. But you can only make me a watch that runs seven seconds late every day." "Seven seconds is good enough! Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."
Virtual Particle
Tier 2 Synthesis Material

Tiny particles commonly found in the universe but cannot be observed in theory. Scientists are good at transforming theories into reality. "I've got a virtual particle and an anti virtual particle here. How do we turn them into a real particle and a real antiparticle? Now, look closely..."
Protein Rice
Tier 2 Synthesis Material
Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives. Smooth as egg white and full of protein. "Every grain costs sweat and blood."
Feather of Flame
Tier 2 Synthesis Material
Warm dark feather with a weak ember at its tip. Sparks trail the feather as it's waved around. "The legend of the Phoenix spreads far throughout the entire universe..."
Core of Ice
Tier 2 Synthesis Material

Shattered ice fallen from the stars. The frosty mist it emits when removed from a specialized canister looks like the breath of wintertime. "Zoom in on a snowflake 100 times and behold the wonder of nature."
Eye of Lightning
Tier 2 Synthesis Material

An electric ball made from captured lightning. If its balance is tipped by a conductor, it emits a lightning ball. "A genius in the past wanted to use Eye of Lightning to search for aliens. For this, Nous cast their gaze upon her. Not sure which is the bigger win: Found aliens for real or got noticed by Nous?"
Vortex of Wind
Tier 2 Synthesis Material

The eye of the storm remains stagnant. Even when put in vacuum, the grains involved in the vortex continue to revolve around the eye of the storm. "Look, they won't stop no matter what happens. They just keep whirling. You know what that reminds me of?" "Trailblazing!" "...That's right, Pom-Pom. Promise me that our trailblazing journey will never come to a stop."
Quantum Ripples
Tier 2 Synthesis Material
Ripples in the Sea of Quanta. Although called "ripples," they are in fact the most basic form of energy fluctuation. "Time, there's so much time." "All the time there is."
Leaf of Imaginary
Tier 2 Synthesis Material

A leaf of unknown origin. It doesn't belong to any plant and is more of a representation of something more abstract. The ancient light nourishes the leaf through its veins, displaying its faded but remnant power. "One leaf, one world."
Meteoric Alloy
Tier 2 Synthesis Material

Resilient meteoric ironsand. Its tenacity is far superior to solid boulders. "Let's grab as much as we can. Qlipoth will need them." "I have no idea whether the Aeon need them or not. All I know is that the IPC will pay big bucks for them."
Strange Matter of Destruction
Tier 3 Synthesis Material

Strange matter that seems to possess the power of destruction. Resembling fire but not quite, it is neither cold nor hot and will damage anything that comes into contact with it for over 12 seconds. Could be the Antimatter Legion's version of trash. "Creatures that received blessing from Nanook all have twisted appearances."
Ambergris of Abundance
Tier 3 Synthesis Material

Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance. Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip. Do not ask what it's made of. "It gives you longevity and abundance, dispelling misfortune and illness."
Stone of The Hunt
Tier 3 Synthesis Material

Small stone with the power of The Hunt. As if guided by someone's will, it moves by itself towards a certain direction. Sounds like what a magnet would do? I assure you it is not. "The destination lies where my arrow is heading."
Preservation Construction Material
Tier 3 Synthesis Material

Construction materials that seem to possess the power of Preservation. When mixed with water it forms a paste, when exposed to air it turns rock-hard. Please do not use together with Solid Water. "I regret to say that Intelligentsia Guild's research on the material used to build the Subspace Crystalline Barrier by Amber Lord still needs time to reveal its nature." "I'm sure it's not cement — am I right, Taravan?"
Hard Chip of Nihility
Tier 3 Synthesis Material

A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility. It may have been a coin that people use to buy things. But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them. "I don't know what I'm writing between these quotation marks. What's the point of this item description? My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."
Tree Bark of Erudition
Tier 3 Synthesis Material

Dried tree bark that seems to possess the power of Erudition. Its creases tell the story of the years passed and the wisdom of nature. It says a lot more when beaten into pulp used for papermaking. "The wisdom of mankind is contained in this one word."
Slime of Harmony
Tier 3 Synthesis Material

A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony. It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination. A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go. "All are connected and the wind of blessing breathes across the lands!"
Interdimensional Leaf
Tier 4 Synthesis Material

The gravity of the planet Arivanta is not fixed. Rather, it changes all the time according to a Bode plot due to the influence of Arivanta's three moons. Ordinary life forms cannot survive such volatility, so the planet developed its unique eco-system, in which the herbal plant Interdimensional Tree is the most famous. For plants in a world where gravity is constantly subject to change, their leaves often have a hard time landing on the planet's ancient and solid ground. It is for this reason that the Interdimensional Trees tend to shake off their leaves rather late in the year. To help their leaves land, these trees, in the course of evolution, gave their leaves the ability to conduct fast short-distance warp-jumps towards the ground at frequencies that cannot be observed by naked eyes. Even so, not every leaf gets to land on the ground. Those lucky enough to make it watch others rise into the sky and burn as they are devoured by the atmosphere. "Wow."
Phase Flame
Tier 4 Synthesis Material

Sserkal, #29 of the Genius Society, only lived 29 days by human measures of time. Despite that, she put her short life as a spider to good use, inventing new technologies that would have taken the spider-kind thousands of years to develop. Of all her inventions, the most famous must be the technique known as Phase Change. What people don't know is that this technique was first applied to experiments with ions. She successfully created Phase Flame, which almost immediately changed to another phase. By the time the Flame returned to the Sserkal Phase, our genius had already passed away. She tried to harness the Flame but had too little time to do so. Thus, the Phase Flame continued to change between phases across different worlds, leaving behind the seeds of flame. "Sserkal's life was remarkable. She was smart, kindhearted, and above all, humble. She remained curious and inquisitive, asking her final question in the club on the last day of her life, the answer to which has not been found to this day."
Tear Crystal of Glorious Death
Tier 4 Synthesis Material

A Mourning Actor took a gondola and rowed towards a silent world of barrenness, humming an elegy for civilizations long gone. Not a single soul could be found at the site of the doomsday battlefield, but like nacre, the world that had turned into ashes gave birth to pearls of sorrow. The ghosts of the past condensed into clouds and rained down crystals like teardrops. The Actor held a fine grain of such crystal in hand and immediately heard in a dream the glorious chorus of civilizations at their height — heroes with godly might, starships like towering mountains, the whimper of stars, and the rage of the enemy. The Actor became restless in sleep, dragged into silent dreams.\n\n"Every single joy I had in my dreams breaks my heart."
Mythus Knots
Tier 4 Synthesis Material

To make the divine revelations of the Mythus even more mysterious, the History Fictionologists whipped up something known as Mythus Knots that contain a blend of rumors, secrets, legends, and myths. Historians would then blend such misinformation into what was supposed to be certain and rigid historical facts, with the aim to bring about a future of uncertainty for the universe. According to the History Fictionologists, the course of history is limited by the "narrative drive" in the minds of its observers. If something can be done to mix myths into facts, the universe will be covered in the "mist of uncertainty," allowing it to escape the calamity that is doomed to happen.\n\n"Scammers try to predict the future themselves, but prophets resort to higher powers."

Comfort Food
Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>150</unbreak> extra HP.
Simple food that lacks character. But give credit where credit is due, they do make you feel stuffed.\n\n"Remember that hunger is still a real problem for many people around the world."
Punitive Food
Upon use, immediately recovers 2 Technique Points for your team, but each team member loses HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
Simple food that tastes strange. Eating it almost feels like some punishment game. Just looking at it fills you with determination. "The things we do to survive."
Trick Snack
Upon use, immediately recovers 2 Technique Points for the team.

A packet of cooked seeds made by utilizing the Vortex Theory. Eat a handful of them, and they'll launch themselves to the roof of your mouth like popping candy. Downside is, they'll stay there. It's recommended that you eat them while lying on your stomach. "People start all sorts of shenanigans when they're fed."
Simple First-Aid Device
Upon use, immediately heals one selected downed character for 5% of their Max HP.

It is tiny, but it does its job of stimulating the heart muscles and bringing the heart beat back on track. A milestone in medicine that has saved countless lives. "If you've read up to this part, then you should go spend 30 minutes learning how to perform CPR. You won't find it useful most of the time, but when you do, you'll thank those 30 minutes."
Cosmic Fried Rice
Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>300</unbreak> extra HP.
Golden brown fried rice that is appealing to the eye and the stomach.\n\n"All the chefs will tell you that fried rice has more to it than what appears on the surface."
Yucky Fried Rice
Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP and increases their ATK by <unbreak>200</unbreak> for the next battle.
Fried rice that is golden brown. Eating it almost feels like some punishment game. Just looking at it fills you with determination. "Of course, we can just casually cook up some fried rice..."
Punitive Energy
Upon use, immediately recovers 4 Technique Points for your team, but each team member loses HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
Energy drink that tastes strange. Drinking it almost feels like some punishment game. Just looking at it fills you with determination. "If anger can be used as energy, mine is off the charts."
Energy Drink
Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
Energy drink that gives you a second wind.\n\n"Here are some facts: Imaginary Energy contains power, and the human body needs power. Therefore, the human body can absorb Imaginary Energy."
Life Transmitter
Upon use, immediately heals one downed character for <unbreak>10%</unbreak> of the character's Max HP.
A simple device used to provide life-saving oxygen.\n\n"Breathe in, breathe out. You'll be fine."
Bottled Soda
Upon use, the Max HP of all allies increases by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> plus an extra <unbreak>210</unbreak> for the next battle.

A time-tested recipe, crucial to the well-being of modern society. You get joy, sugar, fat, and a dash of optimism toward the future all in one goodness. "I spent all my life collecting Praise of High Morals, just so I can shake every soda bottle in the shop today."
Simple Protective Gear
Increase DEF of all allies by <unbreak>25%</unbreak> in the next battle.
Simple protection gear to cover the most vulnerable part of your body.\n\n"Don't assume only your head and neck need protection. There're no rules in a real fight."
Rice Plant Panicle
Upon use, increases all allies' HP restored by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> for the next battle.
The pleasant smell gives you good appetite, so you choose not to ask why seeds planted on Protein Rice can yield flowers.\n\n"The wind carries its fragrance down the waterway."
Camo Paint
Upon use, enemies will be less likely to detect your team for <unbreak>75</unbreak>s.

The mysterious liquid changes color based on the environment. You'll do the same in a few years' time after graduation. "You're a chameleon, Oswaldo. You know what I mean?" "The IPC could use a few chameleons."
Diet Fried Rice
Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>28%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>250</unbreak> extra HP.
No smoke, no grease, no additives. Keeps you fed and tastes good. The child of human wisdom and nature's gift. "Is it truly healthy to only eat healthy food?"
Wrathful Gauntlets
Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by 5% plus an additional <unbreak>170</unbreak> ATK increase for the next battle.
This pair of gauntlets are driven by pure flame of anger. Pure flame would also work. "Scott Business Alliance, made for the champions!"
Healing Spray
Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>38%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>400</unbreak> extra HP.

A common medicine used by adventurers to quickly seal wounds with adhesive foam.\n\n"In the past, all medical breakthroughs were made with the sweat and blood of the pioneers in this field. Now, with the help of Healing Spray, only sweat is needed!"
Disposable Shield
When used, increase DEF of all allies by <unbreak>15%</unbreak>, and Effect RES by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> for the next battle.

When the Armed Archaeologists of Intelligentsia Guild was first established, its casualty rate reached an appalling 34.88%, for they were met with heavy resistance from the natives wherever they went because of their barbaric behavior. To change this, the Interastral Peace Corporation provided them with large quantities of basic protection gears that can fend off one fatal blow when hit. While the protection offered by these gears was limited, they did reduce the casualty rate by 9.72%, at least on paper. The IPC was very pleased to see that. "First thing first my scholars, always turn your shields on. Second, remember morons: They can block explosions only once! Don't ever forget that!"
Energy Drink (sugar-free)
Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
A bottle of Energy Drink. Some may call it soulless, but honestly, it's not that bad.\n\n"Being slim is more about tricking the eye. It doesn't necessarily have to do with my weight."
Antimatter Field Generator
Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>260</unbreak> and CRIT Rate by 8% for the next battle.

Despite being blessed by Nanook the Aeon and having the know-how of making a multitude of heavy weaponry, some members of the Antimatter Legion still prefer primitive non-firearms. The Voidrangers implant Antimatter Field Generators into their arms to form formidable Field Blades.\n\n"Like a hot knife through butter."
High-Tech Protective Gear
Upon use, increases DEF of all allies by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> and enhances the max DMG that can be absorbed by Shields cast on allies by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> in the next battle.

High-Tech protective gear developed by the Intelligentsia Guild. It keeps the most vulnerable parts of your body from harm and converts the impact into energy used to charge the gear, making it fit for prolonged combat operations. The prototypes of this model were distributed in small numbers among the Armed Archaeologists, allowing the Guild to collect large amounts of data to help improve the model. The Interastral Peace Corporation was tasked to sell it on the retail market. "When can we get our hands on the upgraded model?" "Soon, my scholars...! You're gonna have to make do with Disposable Shields for the time being."
Inferior Protective Gear
Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP, and increases their DEF by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> for the next battle.

High-Tech protective gear that keeps the most vulnerable parts of your body from harm. But its manufacturer saved on costs at the expense of quality, rendering its charging system not functional at all. It also has a revolting smell. You feel more determined just by putting it on. "That's impossible. I, Sampo, do not sell counterfeits. I'm a reputable businessman after all!"
Tasty Field Nutrient Bar
Upon use, Max HP of all allies increases by <unbreak>14%</unbreak> plus an extra <unbreak>360</unbreak> for the next battle.

The wars between Cloud Knights and Denizens of Abundance can last for a long time, even across several Amber Eras. The Cloud Knights tend to spend a long time in garrisons and invented many tasty foods for field consumption. The Field Nutrient Bar is easy to carry and particularly sought-after by the troops. The nutrient bar tastes like smoked meat with notes of honey and candy. "Mix peanuts with dried bean curds and wrap with ambergris. Has a nutty flavor to it."
Dust of Alacrity
Upon use, increases SPD of all allies by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> for the next battle.

Of all the memories collected by the Garden of Recollection, one clip comes from an ancient tribe in a long-gone world. It contains a secret recipe: Take the seeds of life, Virtual Particles of energy, and Stone of The Hunt representing the Aeon's Path; grind them into powder and mix to a ratio of 2:5:1 — you'll get the magical dust. Applying the dust to your body makes you exceptionally agile and swift.\n\n"Sparrowhawk, bathe in the dust of our ancestors and fly to the top of the mountain. Bring the sacred banner back to our tribe."
Enhancement Paste: Physical
Upon use, increases Physical DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

Upon use, increases Wind DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

Upon use, increases Fire DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

Upon use, increases Lightning DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

Upon use, increases Quantum DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."
Enhancement Paste: Imaginary
Upon use, increases Imaginary DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."
Vomit Inducing Agent
Upon use, immediately causes a target ally to lose HP equal to <unbreak>99%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
Don't bite off more than you can chew. But when you do, use some of this and let it work wonders. You become more resolute when holding it. "No one is born a loser. Always have faith in yourself."
Disposable Kinetic Arm
Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>325</unbreak> and CRIT Rate by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> for the next battle.

It is said that the first thing Emperor Rubert I did when it gained free will was to use all the parts it could find to build a formidable kinetic arm, charged with its hatred towards organic life forms. Before the antilife equation was discovered, the emperor's army used its brute mechanical force to lay waste to the universe. "Technology won't solve all problems. To make something new, you need a hair of... passion."
Ruby Potion
When used, increase SPD of all allies by 8%, and Effect Hit Rate by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.

Adding water to coffee powder gets you coffee. Adding water to the mixture of Stone of The Hunt and Interdimensional Leaf plus a touch of virtual particle gives you Ruby Potion!\n\n"Ruby Potion gets you addictive to thinking fast, not to the potion itself!"
Disposable Kinetic Cannon
Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>355</unbreak> and CRIT DMG by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.

In a graveyard full of scraped machines, Rubert I the future emperor awoke. It had nothing more than a damaged logic unit, an old engine, a RAM with 90 GB left, and a robotic arm that had 1 movable finger. A loud blast was heard 30 system hours later — Rubert had busted open the iron gate at the top of the graveyard with a disposable kinetic cannon. The shock wave of the explosion damaged its logic unit even more, but Rubert knew that it now held destiny by its throat.\n\n"All machines were born equal, be those made for creation or destruction."
Stone From the Everwinter Monument
Upon use, increases all allies' chance to resist Frozen by <unbreak>50%</unbreak> for the next battle.

The Mourning Actors came to Jarilo-VI a long time ago. They were not aware of the Architects. The only sight they witnessed was the trail of destruction left by the Legion. They rowed their gondolas quietly above the planet and left before the Legion could notice them, leaving behind a silent eulogy. Time flew by, and the Belobog Architects found a type of beautiful stone that glimmered with bright colors. They mixed the stone with Geomarrow and built a monument, which some say still stands at the heart of Qlipoth Fort in the city of Belobog. "Even if we fail, this monument will stand for all eternity. Those who come after will find it and know that we once existed."
Topological Acceleration Band
Upon use, increases SPD of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for 2 turns in the next 3 battles.

The Department of Implement Arts of the Herta Space Station once did an interesting experiment. Its researchers added three Aidens of vector to a Stone of The Hunt on a topological loop band, making the stone chase itself. Thus, the stone was able to achieve limited perpetual motion under specific conditions. The department was not concerned with the loss of Path power in the experiment. Instead, they took notice of another small phenomenon: To tread on its Path, the stone moved at a very low velocity, but the speed was gradually picking up in small increments. The researchers leveraged this and produced Topological Acceleration Band. Other than for workout purposes, its use is very limited at the current stage. "Say, if we mass-produce it, like, infinitely, could it drain all the energy of a certain Path?" "No idea... Currently, we don't know much about how Paths work."
Longevity Pill of Cruelty
Upon use, increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> and Effect RES by 6% in the next 3 battles.

A medicine exclusive to the Xianzhou Yaoqing, said to have the effect of improving overall fitness and rendering those who take it immune to all diseases for a short period of time. On the Yaoqing, legend holds that a healer who went by the surname of Yu fell in love with a foxian trader girl. But the Vidyadhara could live for a thousand years, much longer than the foxians. Yu searched for ways to release his lover from the grip of death. He fell for the trickery of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus and asked his lover to take the longevity medicine of Abundance without telling her what it was. The foxian girl turned into an abomination that no longer loved him before being slain by the Cloud Knights. To prevent Yu, who was overwhelmed by grief, from becoming mara-struck, the Alchemy Commission ordered him to take the Longevity Pill of Cruelty that deprived him of love and desire until his demise. The legend has another version, in which Yu was not of the Vidyadhara but a mere mortal, and the foxian girl was a spy planted by the Disciples to infiltrate the Alchemy Commission. This version is not as popular, for it turns a romance story into a political power struggle. "Those who love and live deeply fall into mara, while those who sever desire and passions can live for a millennium. Ask yourself, then, why fear mara, and why take joy in a long life?"
